labels.name: two_wheeler
labels.definition: Motorcycle, scooter or moped — single-track vehicle, rider usually visible.

labels.name: auto_rickshaw
labels.definition: Three-wheeled petrol/CNG auto rickshaw (tuk-tuk), yellow-black or green-yellow livery.

labels.name: e_rickshaw
labels.definition: Battery-electric three-wheeler (e-rickshaw / e-cart), often green or blue canopy.

labels.name: hatchback
labels.definition: Small passenger car with rear hatch and short rear overhang (Swift/WagonR/i10 class).

labels.name: sedan
labels.definition: Four-door passenger car with a distinct boot (Dzire/City/Corolla class).

labels.name: suv
labels.definition: Tall utility passenger vehicle with high clearance (Scorpio/Fortuner/Innova/Creta class).

labels.name: lcv
labels.definition: Light commercial vehicle under ~3.5 t: mini-truck, pickup, tempo traveller or van (Tata Ace class).

labels.name: bus
labels.definition: Passenger bus or coach — city, school, sleeper or minibus.

labels.name: truck
labels.definition: Goods truck, lorry, dumper or multi-axle trailer — cargo body or tipper.

labels.name: tractor
labels.definition: Agricultural tractor, with or without trolley; restricted on national highways.

labels.name: scene_toll
labels.definition: Toll plaza / boom-barrier checkpoint with vehicles queued or passing.

labels.name: scene_intersection
labels.definition: Signalised or unsignalised intersection with mixed traffic.

labels.name: scene_traffic
labels.definition: Road or highway traffic scene showing mixed Indian vehicle flow.

labels.name: scene_yard
labels.definition: Industrial, warehouse, factory or construction yard entry with commercial vehicles.

labels.name: scene_parking
labels.definition: Parking area or lot with parked vehicles.

labels.name: scene_sign
labels.definition: Road sign, marking or regulatory signage relevant to enforcement.

fields.id: stable content hash of the 512px crop
fields.label: target class
fields.caption: instruction-style sentence ending in the answer
fields.shape_agreement: True when geometric rules corroborate the label
fields.rank: top-4 rule scores at annotation time
fields.bbox_norm: object box in ORIGINAL frame normalised [x0,y0,x1,y1]
fields.features: aspect, edge density, flatness, colour shares, wheel/plate/people counts
fields.in_balanced_core: member of the class-balanced training core
fields.class_weight: inverse-frequency weight for balanced training on the full set
